purpose: Three-generation archive of the OpenEnv 2026 hackathon build: versions/v3_arcadia (29.5GB â€” training scripts for 12 phases, result JSONs, 491MB RL checkpoints, 28.7GB of local GGUF LLM quants, a full llama.cpp build), versions/v4_arcadia_live (22MB â€” live geopolitical realtime pipeline, crisis library, autoresearch experiments), versions/v5_phoenix (2.1GB â€” arena, counterfactual twin, wordle_env, ROLL/DPO integration, receipts framework, plus an 869MB committed-to-disk virtualenv). vendor/ROLL is an untracked full copy of Alibaba's ROLL RL framework (141.8MB, 902 files) used only for a DPO path that never trained. _dump/ is a quarantine of pre-reorg legacy copies plus one-shot reorg/deploy scripts. Critically, this is NOT actually legacy: root server/app.py, 23 scripts, tests, dashboard, rl/lora, Dockerfile.damocles and docker-compose all import from or path-reference versions/ at runtime (102 references across 27 live files).
verdict: This "legacy" tree is a load-bearing archive wearing a museum label. The genuinely good news: the work inside is largely real â€” real training logs (including honestly-recorded failures), real result JSONs with per-judge caches, an ONNX bundle, and FAILURE_TABLE.md is a model of honest engineering record-keeping. The bad news is severe. First, the flagship "grade-A reproducibility receipts" story is materially false on disk: 14 of 20 receipts in versions/v5_phoenix/receipts_v2 are unexecuted stubs (actual: <pending-first-run>, match: false, exit_code: -1) covering the exact headline numbers the README table promises receipts for (mxbai P@1 0.9622, Krippendorff Î±, +26.77% masking lift, GCN MAE), and their reproduce commands use the pre-reorg module path `v3_arcadia.40_granite.*` which is both stale and unimportable (digit-leading package names) â€” they cannot ever run as written. Second, PREPRINT_V5.md's abstract claims "a DPO-fine-tuned Qwen-2.5-3B judge" that never existed: every DPO training attempt crashed (documented in PHOENIX_PUSH_REPORT Â§3.1 and train_gpu.log's AttributeError). Third, the twin receipt PHOENIX_PUSH_REPORT celebrates as match=True sits on disk with exit_code: -9, match: false. Fourth, 31+ GB of the 32GB is local-only bloat (GGUF quants, llama.cpp build, a virtualenv inside the repo tree, a 1.16GB transitions.npz) that has already forced HF-Space deploy contortions. Fifth, live production code is deeply entangled with directories named like an attic. The archive is honest in its diaries and dishonest in its headlines.
